video-v1.alt: A newly built cedar planter box on a sawdust-covered workbench, a drill, screws and a pencil beside it, a garden behind.

video-v2.alt: A harbour quay at sunrise: wet cobblestones, coloured houses along the water and small fishing boats moored in calm water.

video-v3.alt: Three bowls of noodle soup on a wooden table: one with greens, one in a red chilli broth, one with a halved egg.

video-v4.alt: Water carving S-shaped bends through damp sand in a small model river on a table.

video-v5.alt: Meteors streaking across a starry sky over a dark valley, a telescope in silhouette on a ridge.

video-v6.alt: A hand forming a chord on the neck of an acoustic guitar, a living room out of focus behind.

video-v7.alt: An old hand plane on a workbench, rusty on one half and polished to bright steel on the other, among wood shavings.

video-v8.alt: An open carry-on backpack on a bed, packed with rolled clothes, with packing cubes, a toiletry bag and sneakers beside it.

video-v9.alt: Tomato plants with ripe red tomatoes in terracotta pots on a sunny balcony, a watering can pouring at the soil.

video-v10.alt: Old paper maps spread on a desk with a magnifying glass and a brass compass.

video-v11.alt: A piano keyboard beside a rain-streaked window, with a cup of tea and an open notebook on the piano.

video-v12.alt: Five small tents in orange, green, blue, yellow and red pitched on a grassy hillside under a dark stormy sky.
